4. Session was cut off mid-stream; no tool result was ever processed, no review was written

**Did `pdf_to_images` itself work?** It appears to have executed (the call was issued and presumably returned data), but the response payload was so large (base64 image data) that it blew past the 2MB raw output cap, killing the session before the worker could read and act on the results.

**Root cause summary:** `pdf_to_images` returns base64-encoded image data inline in the event stream. At 200 DPI over 4-5 pages, this easily exceeds 2MB, hitting the worker raw output size limit and causing forced termination. The workers need to either use lower DPI, render 1-2 pages at a time, or the images need to be written to disk and returned as file paths rather than inline base64.
